pli-tv-pvr2.10:1.3: avassutā bhikkhunī avassutassa purisapuggalassa adhakkhakaṃ ubbhajāṇumaṇḍalaṃ gahaṇaṃ sādiyati, āpatti pārājikassa.
pli-tv-pvr2.10:1.4: bhikkhu kāyena kāyaṃ āmasati, āpatti saṅghādisesassa.
pli-tv-pvr2.10:1.8: kāyasaṃsaggaṃ sādiyanapaccayā imā pañca āpattiyo āpajjati.
pli-tv-pvr2.10:2.3: bhikkhunī jānaṃ pārājikaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicchādeti, āpatti pārājikassa.
pli-tv-pvr2.10:3.1: yāvatatiyaṃ samanubhāsanāya nappaṭinissajjanapaccayā kati āpattiyo āpajjati :
pli-tv-pvr2.10:3.2: yāvatatiyaṃ samanubhāsanāya nappaṭinissajjanapaccayā pañca āpattiyo āpajjati :
pli-tv-pvr2.10:3.3: ukkhittānuvattikā bhikkhunī yāvatatiyaṃ samanubhāsanāya nappaṭinissajjati, ñattiyā dukkaṭaṃ,
pli-tv-pvr2.10:3.6: bhedakānuvattikā bhikkhunī yāvatatiyaṃ samanubhāsanāya nappaṭinissajjati, āpatti saṅghādisesassa.
pli-tv-pvr2.10:3.7: pāpikāya diṭṭhiyā yāva tatiyaṃ samanubhāsanāya nappaṭinissajjati, āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-pvr2.10:3.8: yāva tatiyaṃ samanubhāsanāya nappaṭinissajjanapaccayā imā pañca āpattiyo āpajjati.
pli-tv-pvr2.10:4.1: aṭṭhamaṃ vatthuṃ paripūraṇapaccayā kati āpattiyo āpajjati :
pli-tv-pvr2.10:4.2: aṭṭhamaṃ vatthuṃ paripūraṇapaccayā tisso āpattiyo āpajjati :
pli-tv-pvr2.10:4.3: purisena “itthannāmaṃ gahanaṃ āgacchā”ti vuttā gacchati āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-pvr2.10:4.6: aṭṭhamaṃ vatthuṃ paripūraṇapaccayā imā tisso āpattiyo āpajjati.
pli-tv-pvr2.10:5.1: ussayavādikā bhikkhunī aḍḍaṃ karaṇapaccayā tisso āpattiyo āpajjati :
pli-tv-pvr2.10:7.1: ekā gāmantaraṃ gamanapaccayā tisso āpattiyo āpajjati :
pli-tv-pvr2.10:7.3: paṭhamaṃ pādaṃ parikkhepaṃ atikkāmeti āpatti thullaccayassa.
pli-tv-pvr2.10:8.1: samaggena saṅghena ukkhittaṃ bhikkhuniṃ dhammena vinayena satthusāsanena anapaloketvā kārakasaṅghaṃ anaññāya gaṇassa chandaṃ osāraṇapaccayā tisso āpattiyo āpajjati :
pli-tv-pvr2.10:9.1: avassutā bhikkhunī avassutassa purisapuggalassa hatthato khādanīyaṃ vā bhojanīyaṃ vā sahatthā paṭiggahetvā bhuñjanapaccayā tisso āpattiyo āpajjati :
pli-tv-pvr2.10:10.1: “kiṃ te ayye eso purisapuggalo karissati avassuto vā anavassuto vā yato tvaṃ anavassutā, iṅghayye yaṃ te eso purisapuggalodeti khādanīyaṃ vā bhojanīyaṃ vā, taṃ tvaṃ sahatthā paṭiggahetvā khāda vā bhuñja vā”ti, uyyojanapaccayā tisso āpattiyo āpajjati :
pli-tv-pvr2.10:10.2: tassā vacanena khādissāmi bhuñjissāmīti paṭigaṇhāti, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-pvr2.10:11.1: kupitā bhikkhunī yāvatatiyaṃ samanubhāsanāya nappaṭinissajjanapaccayā tisso āpattiyo āpajjati :
pli-tv-pvr2.10:12.1: kismicideva adhikaraṇe paccākatā bhikkhunī yāvatatiyaṃ samanubhāsanāya nappaṭinissajjanapaccayā tisso āpattiyo āpajjati :
pli-tv-pvr2.10:13.1: saṃsaṭṭhā bhikkhunī yāvatatiyaṃ samanubhāsanāya nappaṭinissajjanapaccayā tisso āpattiyo āpajjati :
pli-tv-pvr2.10:14.1: “saṃsaṭṭhāvayye tumhe viharatha. mā tumhe nānā viharitthā”ti uyyojentī yāvatatiyaṃ samanubhāsanāya nappaṭinissajjanapaccayā tisso āpattiyo āpajjati :
pli-tv-pvr2.10:16.1: dasasaṅghādisesā niṭṭhitā. yathā heṭṭhā tathā vitthāretabbā, paccayameva nānākaraṇaṃ.
pli-tv-pvr2.10:17.1: dadhiṃ viññāpetvā bhuñjanapaccayā kati āpattiyo āpajjati :
pli-tv-pvr2.10:17.2: dadhiṃ viññāpetvā bhuñjanapaccayā dve āpattiyo āpajjati :
pli-tv-pvr2.10:17.5: dadhiṃ viññāpetvā bhuñjanapaccayā imā dve āpattiyo āpajjati.
